about: The looks the engines can draw. The launch menu is NOT made from saved images: Claude invents proposals and draws a fresh preview for each (references/menu.md). 'offer': false = kept in the skill but not proposed for now.

looks.good_for: What if, documentary, science, sport, suspense — rim light, depth of field, data on screen
history, biographies, maps, myths — ink on parchment, period costumes, humour
comedy skits, gags, Shorts — thick outlines, big expressions
moral short films — a personified temptation, counters, rain, split screens
emotional stories — cream round characters, dark sketchy rooms
emotional stories — black figures, soft light
stick figure vs. software (a stick figure: not offered for now)
classic white stick figures (not offered for now)

everywhere: SCENE (detailed sets: skies, mountains, cities, streets, forests, water, interiors, market, tap-tap, fog, rays), CAM / TRANS (camera moves, transitions), VFX (effects, looks). A video may mix looks or invent a new one in its own sets.js.
